remarks: Picture a warm Ventura evening: doors open, citrus picked from the yard, birds gathering at the fountains, and dinner shared outdoors. In a neighborhood where homes rarely become available, this is a home carefully created, deeply enjoyed, and ready for its next chapter. Set in sought-after Ashwood Estates above Ventura College, 379 McGill Ave is a distinctive multi-level home designed for comfort, privacy, entertaining, and indoor-outdoor living. Custom window treatments complement warm bamboo flooring and natural light, while the multi-level layout creates a natural separation between gathering spaces and private retreats. At the heart of the home, the kitchen pairs custom maple cabinetry
